intro: Thadius Grimshade asks you to give him room while he performs a ritual of divination. He means to follow the link between the feather you brought and its owner until it leads him to Sharpbeak.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Give me room while I perform a ritual of divination. I will find the connection between the feather you brought me and its owner, and follow that connection to Sharpbeak himself.
That is... I will if all goes according to plan. If it does not, then... You better close your eyes.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The ritual was a success. I have seen Sharpbeak and can tell you how to find him.
